damage_story: A localized west-side collapse destroys one receiving bay and buries part of the raw-material cell while the offices, later production stages, powerhouse, catwalk and outbound docks survive.
damage_zone: west receiving roof, first loading bay and raw-material storage
environment_layer: continuous gravel and cracked masonry rubble beneath the failed receiving roof
fallen full-block steel and copper members across the damaged input lane
scrap and refuse concentrated beside the interrupted raw-material route
weathered staff road, receiving apron and outbound truck court
occupation_layer: industrial loot retained in the surviving maintenance room
pillagers occupying the protected upper engineering offices
invariants: north entrance, both office floors and office stair survive
office-to-production threshold and central manufacturing aisles remain navigable
mixing, pressing, assembly, maintenance and quality-control routes survive
powerhouse, production catwalk and independent catwalk stair survive
all three south outbound dock approaches remain accessible
damage remains localized to the west receiving failure
